scope: Local antirez-compat-audit worktree; no remote cleanup
limits: Counts are a point-in-time inventory, not exclusive physical storage on a deduplicating filesystem.
Archive member samples match extracted files; complete duplicate verification has not been performed.
Do not interpret archive size as automatically removable space.
Branches retain tracked source, patches, recipes and reports; ignored raw evidence and retained executables need separate storage.
The new Git worktree will not copy ignored .deps, evidence or run directories.
